searchText: I created this api to get sync committee root, could someone have a look 🙏🏻 https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/265 What range of states are this APIs expected to support? whichever ones you’ve got in your database all of them if you’ve got all historic states stored, or just the unfinalized part of the chain otherwise if running in pruned mode supporting phase0 will require a bit of extra work but it shouldn’t be too bad I’ve got someone interested in working on the Lodestar impl. Will introduce you!
